title: Archive
summary: The read-out for the Internet Archive bridge: which of its three doors answered from this machine, how long each took, and what the console may conclude from them.

surfaces.usb: DEGRADED(promotion pending - authored and certified on PC first, then carried to the stick per-file and hash-verified, where the stick runs its own suite)
surfaces.web: N/A(by steward decision 2026-09-25 - web parity is decided in WO-0002)

notes: The read-out half of the archive pair. It owns nothing, writes nothing and holds no state: every fact is asked of the harness `wayback` (src/wayback.py) and painted as it was told. What it answers is the question a failure would otherwise answer too late - is the Internet Archive reachable from THIS machine, which of its three doors answered, how long each took, and what the console is allowed to conclude from them. The probe is three cheap calls, cached in the harness for two minutes, so a panel that polls cannot become three network round trips every thirty seconds. A door that did not answer is a NAMED GAP that drags the card off green, never a zero.
